messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a big ArgoCD sync queue spike in eu-west at ~13:07. App-of-apps that manages GPU pools stayed OutOfSync, new nodepools never provisioned.
kevin: Any obvious errors in the repo-server/controller logs?
maria: Paste from argocd-repo-server log: `panic: runtime: out of memory` and repeated `error fetching repo` entries followed by Helm hook failures.
ops-bot: [alert] argocd-repo-server OOMKilled on eu-west-1 cluster (13:09).
lina: I also see a lot of failed Helm post-sync jobs in the target namespace — jobs stuck in Pending due to PVC creation errors. Could be storageclass drift from yesterday's terraform change.
david: Confirmed: `kubectl get pods -n argocd` shows repo-server in CrashLoopBackOff, memory spiking before OOM. application-controller lagging behind (~1200s).
maria: Quick mitigation: scaled repo-server from 1->3 and restarted application-controller: `kubectl scale deploy argocd-repo-server -n argocd --replicas=3` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy argocd-application-controller -n argocd`. Also requeued stuck apps with `argocd app sync <app> --prune`.
kevin: Good. What was blocking the Helm jobs? PVC errors? share sample error.
maria: Helm job error: `FailedAttachVolume: node didn't have plugin set up` then `persistentvolumeclaim "gpu-pool-claim" not found` — TF changed storageclass name from fast-ssd -> premium-ssd so the PVCs couldn't bind. Post-sync hook tried to create resources referencing old PVCs.
lina: That explains the hooks failing and finalizers keeping apps in terminating state. I patched one app to remove finalizers so the app-of-apps could proceed: `kubectl patch application <child-app> -n argocd --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/metadata/finalizers"}]'`
david: After scaling repo-server the queue drained slowly but still getting high concurrency of app syncs. I reduced concurrent fanout: updated argocd-cm to lower `app-of-apps.concurrentSyncs` from 40 -> 8 and set `repoSyncBatchSize: 4` to throttle bursts.
kevin: Nice. Any follow-up changes needed in CI/CD to avoid this in future?
maria: Action items: 1) ENGINFRA-3421 — reconcile TF storageclass rename and update chart values to avoid dangling PVC references. 2) Add a pre-sync validation hook to app-of-apps that checks storageclass existence. 3) Add repo-server HPA / OOM guard and raise memory request for repo-server. 4) Improve rollout automation to stagger app-of-apps waves (lower maxConcurrent during large updates).
deploy-bot: [deploy] argocd-cm configmap updated (retries: 2) by maria.
kevin: After fixes, GPU pools started provisioning at 13:56. Verified nodes with `kubectl get nodes -l cloud.redwood/gpu=true` — new nodes joined.
maria: Confirmed end-to-end: apps synced, hooks completed, no more OOMs. Leaving ENGINFRA-3421 for follow-ups. Thanks all :thumbsup:
